params.body:
`bin/crontab-install --apply` installs `ops/crontab` as the whole crontab. The October enrich backfill was added on the box by hand on 11 October and was not in this file, so installing the judge line from #333 removed it.

This puts that line back, word for word, with a comment saying what it does and when it goes: 500 promoted signals without a concept go back to enrich at 18:30 each evening, only when none of the previous batch is still waiting.

After the merge, `bin/crontab-install --apply` on the box installs it again. Remove the line in a later PR when `node bin/enrich-backfill.mjs --progress` shows October done.
params.title: ops/crontab: keep the October enrich backfill
